about: S3 虹橋 (the Rainbow Bridge): who speaks and what (the life pass, gen/life/progress.md; format tools/talk_data.mjs; pilot sections/outer_road/talk.json). Lines come from 名画记 18–25 and 1, 9, 余辉 2015/2021/2023, 《東京夢華錄》, 《澠水燕談錄》 and the map; where the readings disagree, each scene's `reading` says which we follow. scenes: near talks (press E at the host; `as` = the line for who you play, `again` = the next talk with the same host). Hosts stand where you can reach them (the deck, the banks, the tavern's forecourt): the boat crews and the upstairs diners speak only through chatter. chatter: groups that talk among themselves when you are within earshot. barks: a lone figure's word now and then (`close`: a call to you as you come near). Every role is a painted figure of people.json; every line cites its reading (src); 繁體, no numbers on screen; lines fit the figure's clips. Plot-line steps told here: grain.3 (V3.10, c3.grain), wine.1 (V3.5, c3.diners), charcoal.2 (V3.7, c3.smalltavern), boat.1 (V3.2, c3.bigboat), boat.2 (V3.1, c3.rail), screen.2 (V3.6, c3.chuanche). Bundled by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/talk.json.

scenes.title: 上下呼救
scenes.reading: 名画记 19, 20: as the boat comes under the arch, people on the bridge throw down ropes and a man on the boat's roof takes them; the crowd shouts, points, gives advice, reaches out and cannot help. 余辉 2015 看点三: people above and below see the danger and shout (上下呼救), and a rope is thrown so the crew will not fall in; 2021: the bow is swung across to slow her, and ship and bridge come out safe. 名画记 calls her a laden cargo boat, 余辉 a big passenger boat of two or three hundred: we follow 余辉 for what she is and why she is in danger (the trackers towed her too close), 名画记 for the crew's work. The map: a youth leans over the near railing with a line in his hand, a man at the crown hangs far over as if lowering a rope, a capped man leans out with an arm raised; below, two boatmen point the way at the bow and one pushes a pole up at the arch.

scenes.title: 大船搶險
scenes.reading: 名画记 19: laden boats come upstream one after another; here the river is narrow and fast and the bridge low, so the whole crew works at once: some lower the mast, some pole hard, some brace poles against the bridge, some shout to the boats ahead. 余辉 2015/2021 (chosen for what she is and why she is in danger): a big passenger boat whose mast is about to strike the bridge because the trackers towed her too close; the crew drop the mast, one man braces a long pole against the beam, the polers swing her bow across to slow her; on the bridge and the banks everyone holds his breath. The map: on the south bank under the arch a man waves his arm high at the boat from behind the shed, another looks up; on board, men push poles up at the arch, the stern hands haul the mast's lines, a man in the after cabin's door holds a long pole out past the stern.

scenes.title: 車轎相爭
scenes.reading: 余辉 2015 看点三 (chosen): on the bridge a civil official in a sedan and a military officer on horseback meet and neither gives way; the bearers and the horseman's men each lean on their master's rank and quarrel, adding a second danger on the deck to the one under it; 2021: the deck is narrowed by stalls on both sides (侵街), the attendants of a civil official and a general argue and it all becomes a tangle. 名画记 20 reads only the crowd. The map: the sedan carried up the south ramp, a man at its front pointing up the bridge, two men in wide hats pointing back at it; the rider in white coming down, his groom hugging the horse's lowered neck, a man in front flinging his arms wide. No passenger shows in the closed sedan, so none speaks; the rider is 余辉's 武官, named 官人 here. Which side each pointing man is on is our reading.

scenes.title: 無柱飛橋
scenes.reading: 名画记 18: a pierless timber arch; the Bian rises and falls violently and wrecks pier bridges nearly every year, but this one is not struck by the current and lasts fifty years; it was thought up by a soldier held in a prison camp, and afterwards every bridge on the Bian copied it; Ming and Qing copies paint it as a stone arch. 《澠水燕談錄》卷八: in Qingzhou a discharged prison-camp soldier (牢城廢卒) built the first 飛橋 with no piers; it stood fifty years; 陳希亮 had it copied on the Bian, 'commonly called 虹橋'. 《東京夢華錄》卷一 河道: 虹橋, seven li outside the East Water Gate, no piers, great timbers spanned in the air, painted red, like a flying rainbow. 余辉 2021 notes that the painter wrote no name on the bridge (thirteen crossed the Bian); our old man uses the common name. The map: people in dark robes on the south bank under the arch's foot by the end post (表木) look up at the bridge and the boat.

scenes.title: 十千腳店
scenes.reading: 名画记 24: the tavern door is lively; a horse is tied outside the fence, some guest's upstairs, and its groom sits on the ground inside the fence resting (the map's faint figure behind the lamp-box, re-read as seated for question 8, gen/life/q8_figures.md: he is the groom; the narrow figure at the gate's east post is the keeper, our proposal). 名画记 23: the 新酒 banner; wine tax was huge and wine a state monopoly; 新酒 is the wine sold from around mid-autumn. 《東京夢華錄》卷二: every tavern ties a 彩樓歡門 over its door; seventy-two 正店, the rest called 腳店; 卷五: a 正店 lends silver to a 腳店 that buys its wine a few times. 余辉 2023: the lamp-boxes of 孫記正店 and 十千腳店 are the earliest lit signs, candles inside at night. 余辉 2021: in such houses the dearest wines, 羊羔酒 at eighty cash a measure, 銀瓶酒 at seventy-two; at least half a string a head. The map: the narrow figure at the gate's east post, the faint man seated inside the bar fence behind the lamp-box, a waiter walking out with a plate, diners upstairs. The groom is 名画记 24's; the keeper is our proposal. The season the 新酒 banner implies (孔憲易: autumn) is told in the lore, not argued here.
